result_summary: Prometeo continuous improvement is now preserve-first, externally durable and host-routed: disposable workers are governed by one mandatory constitution and execution protocol; live-write collisions are distinguished from historical overlap; Page Change results return to the single Universal Host; the Change Loop is translucent/readable and polls durable execution results; atomic promotion and live GitHub Pages byte verification are in place.
useful_delta: GLOBAL_AGENT_CONSTITUTION_V1 is mandatory before material work and makes ordinary change requests deltas against authoritative Current rather than reconstruction permission.
Compiled Agent Runtime packets carry constitution-aware guidance and active-writer collision semantics; completed/historical write scopes are not treated as live locks.

PROMETEO EXECUTE lifecycle is hardened around constitution -> fetch/validate -> reincarnate/resync -> claim -> owner/thread recovery -> prewrite -> execute/test -> persist/return/receipt -> thread update -> release.
Universal Control V5 understands host routes `?page=<page_id>&changes=<work_item_id>` and can load the page plus its selected result without creating a child shell.
Page Change Feed now polls execution status before overview/detail so a durable GitHub RETURN can appear without the human reopening or reading the worker chat.
Change Loop controls use component-owned high-contrast colors and a translucent/frosted surface, preventing arbitrary page palettes from making action labels invisible.
An atomic main promotion workflow rebuilds the tested V5 candidate, promotes manifested bytes with a pre-write resync/rebase and leaves the existing publisher to verify live GitHub Pages bytes.
PR #18 merged without overwriting concurrent Study Library work; promotion commit d86f8ef7c4e372d0ea1585ffe08642491a1da940 was produced by the guarded workflow.
Publish Prometeo Universal Shell V5 run 34531455535 completed SUCCESS including live GitHub Pages byte verification.
decisions: The chat is a disposable executor, never project memory or product authority.
The human interaction surface for iterative development is the page-scoped Change Thread/Feed inside Prometeo.
Raw page URLs are evidence/preview destinations; primary result navigation remains inside the Universal Host.
No second Universal Control, page-local global navigation, second Capture owner, second Current or competing continuity architecture may be created.
Preserve-first/surgical mutation is the default; clean-slate replacement requires explicit human intent or a migration contract with equivalence evidence.
Before material writes, agents re-check the latest EPOCH/compiled packet, exact owner/file and relevant convergence; concurrent writes are reconciled rather than overwritten.
Private Capture payloads remain private; public coordination contains protocols, schemas, digests and sanitized returns only.
negative_knowledge: Do not tell the user to return to a specific old chat for recoverable context.
Do not ask the user to copy large prompts between Prometeo-aware workers.
Do not return raw child pages as the main completion link.
Do not silently replace accepted behavior because a newer/highest-numbered artifact exists.
Do not let stale completed workers block unrelated or newly claimed writes.
Do not mark a result seen merely because it synced; seen requires explicit result opening/deep-link intent.
Do not couple Change Loop readability to the active child page theme.

human_boundary: No human decision is required to continue ordinary improvement. That use can discover new product bugs but is not a missing implementation gate.
